anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Firstborn perish; the people go out.
Pharaoh regrets the exodus and pursues with chariots.
Egypt drowned in the Red Sea; Israel passes through.

pass_a_gloss: And these things having happened, the people come out of Egypt and the Egyptians' firstborn perish, and Pharaoh after the Hebrews' exodus regrets, and with the army and the chariots pursuing them he comes out, and so is sunk in the Red Sea, and Moses with the people goes through the sea.
pass_b_english: And when these things have been done, the people come out of Egypt, and the firstborn of the Egyptians perish. After the Hebrews' going out, Pharaoh regrets it. He comes out pursuing them with the army and the chariots, and so is drowned in the Red Sea. Moses with the people passes through the sea.
source_text: Καὶ τούτων γενομένων ὁ λαὸς τὴν Αἴγυπτον ἐξέρχεται καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἀπόλυται, καὶ ὁ Φαραὼ μετὰ τὴν|| τῶν Ἑβραίων ἔξοδον μεταμέλεται, καὶ ἅμα τῇ στρατιᾷ καὶ τοῖς ἅρμασιν καταδιώκων αὐτοὺς ἐξέρχεται, καὶ οὕτως ἐν τῇ Ἐρυθ[ρ]ᾷ θαλάσσῃ καταποντίζε[τα]ι, καὶ Μωϋσῆς σὺν τῷ λ[αῷ] διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης διέρχετ[αι].
